positions.name: DirectKnowledgeRemoval
positions.frame: what does it mean to direct the removal of knowledge from the record?
positions.why: Both segments are imperatives commanding erasure of specific knowledge, performed with the same authority-ranking stance and pressure. They share a future/irrealis temporal projection and a decision-level conviction, naming particular artifacts (the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work) as targets for total removal. The intensifiers 'entirely' and 'all' reinforce a shared directional read of absolute deletion.
